style.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF and light grey #EDEFF1 seamless panels for product shots; mint-cyan #86C9C5 and muted slate #9A9CA8 panels for feature and information screens; a single deep slate-teal #2E4A4E panel only on the closing screen

style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh airy summer cooling-appliance visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white background #FFFFFF, light neutral panel #EDEFF1, deep ink #2B3A42 and one coral accent #F08A6D, with one mint-cyan secondary #86C9C5 kept as a panel fill in feature screens; cool bright diffused studio lighting with a front-left key and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif headline type; consistent rounded pill label chips and thin-line icons; clean high-end appliance photography mixed with minimal infographic panels; stable upright product scale with the head up and handle down and a consistent slight 3/4 hero angle; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable upright product scale with the round fan head up and the handle down, consistent slight 3/4 hero angle and clean silhouette with a soft contact shadow; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins
style.surfaceSystem: matte seamless paper, light grey marble-grain block pedestals #DCDEE1 and a light wood desk #C9A57B, no busy texture
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headline type, ink #2B3A42 on light panels and #FFFFFF on dark panels, labels in rounded pill chips; mint-cyan #86C9C5 kept as a secondary panel fill rather than a text color
